data.summary:
AI/ML Specialist with 9+ years of experience, including the last 2 years focused on Generative AI (GenAI). Strong expertise in Deep Learning, Computer Vision (OpenCV), and advanced ML algorithms. Skilled in building robust AI solutions for image recognition, object detection, object tracking, and real-time video analysis. Recent experience includes LLM-based application deployment, prompt engineering, fine-tuning large language models, and production deployment of GenAI chatbots.
Highlights
9+ years of experience in developing AI/ML-powered full-stack applications for web and mobile platforms.
5+ years of experience in AI architecture, Generative AI model optimization, and AI-driven automation.
Expertise in AI & ML: NLP, Computer Vision, Predictive Analytics, LLMs (GPT, BERT), TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI, Hugging Face.
Solution Architect: Designing AI-integrated web and mobile applications using Java, Python, React.js, Node.js, and Spring Boot.
Cloud & DevOps: AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
Security & Compliance: AI-powered fraud detection, Play Integrity, cryptographic security, IAM roles, penetration testing.
Technical Documentation: Experienced in maintaining SRS, Wiki pages, AI model documentation, and product roadmaps.
AI-Powered SDK Development: Designed and optimized AI-driven SDKs (JAR/AAR) for mobile security and biometric authentication.
Messaging & Event Processing: Kafka, RabbitMQ for AI-driven real-time event streaming.
Full-Stack AI Development: Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Microservices, RESTful & GraphQL APIs.
Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Agile, Scrum, Waterfall methodologies with AI-focused development.
Strong Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to lead AI teams, interact with stakeholders, and deliver projects on time.
